versions.localizedDescription: Hermey 0.1. Transcript opens at the end; scroll-to-latest appears; menu has Compact + Reset; one microphone in the composer; composer follows the caret; window transparency slider.
Bot portrait in the chat header, About/Settings build info, mic inside the composer, plus the window/搜索/sidebar polish.

Third line: the conversation's newest message (both apps). Mac: scroll-to-latest appears, microphone beside send, About panel + Settings > About with the build number, the bot's own icon in the chat header.
Bot list: a third line with the conversation's newest message, on Mac and iPhone. A working scroll-to-latest on both. Mac: clickable links, and Shift+Return breaks the line at the caret.

Composer: Shift+Return breaks the line; the attachment menu anchors on the paperclip. Header magnifier searches the conversation; the palette keeps its highlight in view. Read aloud under every reply. Bot rows gain a third line: the newest message.
